components.css: .ds-transaction-row{width:100%;min-height:64px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:86px 34px minmax(116px,1fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:7px 28px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #e5ecec;background:var(--teal-soft,#dff2f1);color:var(--ink,#072b3a);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--teal,#008d8b);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease}.ds-transaction-row:hover{background:#d4ecec}.ds-transaction-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(0,141,139,.28);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-row-date,.ds-merchant{display:grid;gap:3px}.ds-row-date strong,.ds-merchant strong{font:650 12.5px/1.2 'Manrope Variable',sans-serif}.ds-row-date small,.ds-merchant small{color:#466571;font:400 11px/1.2 'Manrope Variable',sans-serif}.ds-merchant-icon{width:33px;height:33px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:10px;background:#e6f5f0;color:#087d64}.ds-amount{font:700 13.5px/1 'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}

components.name: Receipt Inspector
components.description: Signature paper receipt for the currently selected transaction.
components.css: .ds-receipt{position:relative;padding:19px 20px 18px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#072b3a);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(11,48,58,.09);font-family:'Manrope Variable',sans-serif}.ds-receipt:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-7px;height:8px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 7px 0,transparent 7px,#fff 7.6px) 0 0/14px 8px repeat-x}.ds-receipt header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-bottom:17px;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line-strong,#b8cacc)}.ds-receipt header span{display:grid;gap:2px}.ds-receipt header small,.ds-receipt section small{color:#607981;font-size:9px}.ds-receipt header strong{font-size:12px}.ds-receipt header b{color:var(--success,#15845e)}.ds-receipt section{display:grid;gap:4px;padding:18px 0 14px}.ds-receipt section strong{font:700 34px/1.05 'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-receipt dl{display:grid;gap:9px;margin:0;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line-strong,#b8cacc)}.ds-receipt dl div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9.5px}.ds-receipt dt{color:#647c85}.ds-receipt dd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin:0;font-weight:650}.ds-receipt dd i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--success,#15845e)}

narrative.overview: Hisab turns a bank receipt into an ongoing financial record: the dense transaction ledger and the selected transaction’s human purpose stay visible together. The interface feels calm, exact, and private—closer to a well-kept account book than a promotional fintech dashboard. It deliberately avoids a generic grid of metric cards. The system combines mineral-paper surfaces, petrol ink, thin ruled dividers, restrained turquoise actions, small saffron signals, and condensed financial figures. Density is intentional: desktop preserves a scan-efficient operating surface, while smaller layouts progressively remove secondary metadata and recast rows for touch without losing the transaction-and-receipt relationship.
keyCharacteristics: Receipt-led split view with a dense ledger and contextual inspector.
Deep-ink navigation rail and pale, low-chroma working surfaces.
Turquoise reserved for actions, selection, connectivity, and trustworthy emphasis.
Condensed numerals for balances and amounts; humanist sans-serif for working text.
Ruled lines, dashed receipt separators, and tonal fills provide most structure.

rules.name: The Action-Only Turquoise Rule
rules.body: Turquoise signals an available action, active selection, or confirmed connection; it is not decorative background color.

rules.name: The Saffron Restraint Rule
rules.body: Saffron remains a small signal for demo status or attention and never competes with transaction content.

rules.name: The Financial Figure Rule
rules.body: Use Roboto Condensed for balances and transaction amounts, not prose or navigation.

rules.name: The Dense-but-Legible Rule
rules.body: Small metadata is supported by strong contrast, short phrases, generous row height, and clear grouping; do not shrink primary actions or merchant names to metadata scale.

rules.name: The Paper-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer borders, paper tones, and selection fills before adding a shadow.

dos: Do keep the ledger and selected receipt visually connected on wide screens.
Do reserve Roboto Condensed for balances and transaction amounts.
Do use thin solid rules for interface structure and dashed rules for receipt/accounting semantics.
Do preserve keyboard focus outlines, readable contrast, text status labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do simplify secondary metadata responsively while preserving merchant, amount, date, and note context.
donts: Don't replace the operating surface with a generic grid of detached metric cards.
Don't use turquoise as a decorative wash across large regions; its rarity carries interaction meaning.
Don't round the signature receipt into an ordinary card or remove its dashed and scalloped paper cues.
Don't introduce heavy shadows on routine controls and cards.
Don't imply money movement, live-bank certification, or production connectivity through visual language or copy.
